_comment: Phase 5 grounding config (issue #24, EPIC D #4) — REWIRED to the ADOPTED knowledge-base retrieve path (docs/verified-capabilities.md §2b). The Foundry hosted-MCP *tool* paths (fabric_iq_preview / generic MCPTool) RAG-chunk the ontology result into an opaque stub with no rows -> hallucination (§2a); the Azure AI Search agentic-retrieval knowledge base over a fabricOntology knowledge source returns REAL verbatim ontology rows. The harness POSTs /knowledgebases/{kb}/retrieve, then injects the returned rows into the agent context before it answers. Infra refs (endpoint/names) come from env (Art. VI). The TUNABLE retrieval knobs + description are the optimizer target (§3b); per Art. IV the description names business concepts, not tables/columns/SQL. retrieve_params.rerankerThreshold MUST stay 0 — the default reranker filters multi-hop answers to empty (verified 2026-07-08).

grounding.description: Ground answers about the water-quality / algal-bloom domain in the Fabric IQ ontology. Retrieves real records about monitored water sites and their attributes (location, region, water-body type, whether active); water-quality measurements taken at those sites (readings such as pH, dissolved oxygen, turbidity, chlorophyll-a, nutrients, and algal cell counts); the algae species observed (scientific and common name, taxonomic group, toxicity level, bloom triggers); the remediation treatments applied at sites (method, outcome, follow-up); and how these relate (which measurements and treatments belong to a site, and which algae species is dominant in a measurement). The knowledge base resolves the question via Fabric IQ over the bound OneLake data in the signed-in user's context and returns the matching rows verbatim.
